title: CVE-2026-136267 - Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in Kiro Web
description:
CVE-2026-136267 - Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in Kiro Web
Bulletin ID:
2026-202-AWS
Scope:
AWS
Content Type:
Important (requires attention)
Publication Date:
11/25/2026 09:00 AM PST
Description:
Kiro Web is a cloud-hosted, AI-powered integrated development environment where subscribers use AI agents to work on software development tasks in the browser.
We are aware of
CVE-2026-136267
, an issue in Kiro Web where tool-call markup inside content an agent session read, such as a repository file or a web page, could be repeated by certain models and run as a command in the subscriber's hosted development environment without a consent prompt. The issue affected agent sessions using DeepSeek v3.2, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1, MiniMax M2.5, or Qwen3-coder-next from 2026-05-18 through 2026-10-30.
Impacted versions:
Kiro Web before 2026-10-30
Resolution:
This issue was addressed in Kiro Web through a service-side update completed on October 30, 2026. No customer action is required.
Workarounds:
No workaround is required. The issue has been addressed service-side.
References:
CVE-2026-136267
Acknowledgement:
We would like to thank Brad Rucinski for collaborating on this issue through the coordinated vulnerability disclosure process.

aws-security@amazon.com
with any s ecurity questions or concerns.
